s1.text: 你在北京的一个市场。人很多，你饿了。
s1.en: You're at a market in Beijing. There are lots of people, and you're hungry.

choices.en: I want to eat a jianbing.
I want to drink juice.

s2.text: 一位阿姨在卖煎饼，一个八块钱。
s2.en: An auntie is selling jianbing, eight yuan each.

choices.en: I'll have one, with an egg.
Do you have one that isn't spicy?

s3.en: There's orange juice, and watermelon juice too.

choices.en: I'll have an orange juice.
I'll have a watermelon juice.

s4.text: 真好吃！现在你想去博物馆。你怎么去？
s4.en: Delicious! Now you want to go to the museum. How do you go?

choices.en: I'll walk.
I'll take the subway.

s4b.text: 有，不辣的也很好吃！现在你想去博物馆。
s4b.en: Yes, the mild one is delicious too! Now you want to go to the museum.

choices.en: I'll walk.
I'll take the subway.

s5.text: 果汁很凉。太好了！一个小朋友问你：“你是哪国人？”
s5.en: The juice is nice and cold. Great! A child asks you: “What country are you from?”

choices.en: I'm American.
I'm Canadian.

s6.text: 小朋友笑了：“欢迎来中国！”现在你想去博物馆。
s6.en: The child smiles: “Welcome to China!” Now you want to go to the museum.

choices.en: I'll walk.
I'll take the subway.

end_walk.text: 你一边走一边看，看到了很多漂亮的胡同。完美的一天！
end_walk.en: You look around as you walk and see lots of pretty hutongs. A perfect day!

end_metro.text: 地铁很快，可是你坐错了方向。你到得晚了，但是很开心！
end_metro.en: The subway is fast, but you went the wrong direction. You arrive late, but happy!

adventures.title: 小猫去哪儿了？
adventures.en: The mystery of the missing cat

s1.text: 你的邻居王阿姨来敲门。她很着急：她的猫“咪咪”昨天晚上不见了。
s1.en: Your neighbour, Auntie Wang, knocks on the door. She's very worried: her cat, Mimi, went missing last night.

choices.text: 您最后一次看到它是什么时候？
choices.en: When did you last see it?
Have you looked in the park?

s2.text: 她说十点的时候还在阳台上看到它。今天早上，她发现窗户开着。
s2.en: She says she still saw it on the balcony at ten. This morning she found the window open.

choices.en: Let's go and look at the balcony.
Let's ask the security guard.

s3.text: 她说没有，她一个人不敢去。你们一起去了公园，可是只看到了鸽子。
s3.en: She says no, she was scared to go alone. You go to the park together, but you only see pigeons.

choices.en: Let's ask the security guard.
Let's go back and look at the balcony.

s4.text: 阳台上有一些小小的脚印，一直通到邻居家的屋顶。
s4.en: On the balcony there are some little paw prints, leading all the way to the neighbour's roof.

choices.en: Let's follow the paw prints.
Let's ask the next-door neighbour.

s5.text: 保安笑着说：“昨天晚上，我在街角的面包店看到一只灰色的猫。”
s5.en: The guard laughs: “Last night I saw a grey cat at the bakery on the corner.”

choices.en: Let's go to the bakery!
Are you sure it was grey?

s6.text: 脚印在一个旧纸箱前面停了。纸箱里面好像有东西在动……
s6.en: The paw prints stop in front of an old cardboard box. Something seems to be moving inside…

choices.en: I gently open the box.
I call Auntie Wang to open it.

s7.text: 邻居说，凌晨的时候他听到了猫叫，就在面包店附近。
s7.en: The neighbour says that in the early hours he heard meowing, right near the bakery.

choices.en: Let's go to the bakery!
Let's go back to the balcony.

s8.text: 在面包店里，咪咪正睡在烤箱旁边，又舒服又暖和。
s8.en: In the bakery, Mimi is sleeping next to the oven, comfy and warm.

choices.en: Auntie Wang, we found it!

choices.text: 我给王阿姨买个面包庆祝一下。
choices.en: I buy Auntie Wang some bread to celebrate.

s9.text: “嗯……灰色还是白色，我也不太确定，天太黑了。”保安说。
s9.en: “Hmm… grey or white, I'm not really sure, it was too dark,” says the guard.

choices.text: 我们还是去面包店看看吧。
choices.en: Let's go and check the bakery anyway.

choices.text: 我们还是先看看阳台吧。
choices.en: Let's check the balcony first.

end_box.text: 是咪咪！它被困在纸箱里了。王阿姨高兴得哭了。
end_box.en: It's Mimi! It was stuck in the box. Auntie Wang cries with happiness.

end_kittens.text: 王阿姨打开纸箱：里面有三只小猫！原来咪咪当妈妈了！
end_kittens.en: Auntie Wang opens the box: there are three kittens inside! Mimi has become a mum!

end_bakery.text: 王阿姨抱住了咪咪。面包店老板说，它随时可以再来。
end_bakery.en: Auntie Wang hugs Mimi. The baker says it can come back any time.

end_bread.text: 王阿姨、咪咪和你一起吃刚出炉的面包当早饭。案子破了！
end_bread.en: Auntie Wang, Mimi and you have fresh bread for breakfast. Case solved!

s1.text: 你坐在从上海开往北京的夜车上。半夜，一位乘客大叫：她奶奶留给她的项链被人偷了。
s1.en: You're on the night train from Shanghai to Beijing. At midnight a passenger cries out: the necklace her grandmother left her has been stolen.

choices.text: 我请她把经过详细地告诉我。
choices.en: I ask her to tell me exactly what happened.

choices.text: 我去找列车员，不让任何人下车。
choices.en: I go and find the train attendant, so nobody gets off.

s2.text: 她说她睡着了，醒来的时候首饰盒已经开了。只有两个人走过车厢：一位音乐家和一位穿西装的先生。
s2.en: She says she fell asleep, and when she woke up the jewellery box was already open. Only two people walked through the carriage: a musician and a man in a suit.

choices.en: I go and talk to the musician.

choices.text: 我去跟穿西装的先生谈谈。
choices.en: I go and talk to the man in the suit.

s3.text: 列车员锁上了车门，请你帮忙，因为车厢里只有你醒着。火车一个小时以后才会停。
s3.en: The attendant locks the doors and asks for your help, since you're the only one awake in the carriage. The train won't stop for another hour.

choices.en: I go and question the musician.

choices.text: 我在过道里找找有没有线索。
choices.en: I search the aisle for clues.

s4.text: 音乐家很紧张，说他只是去了一趟洗手间。他的吉他装在琴盒里，可是琴盒重得不像是空的。
s4.en: The musician is nervous and says he only went to the toilet. His guitar is in its case, but the case is too heavy to be empty.

choices.en: I ask him to open the case.

choices.text: 没有证据，最好不要随便怀疑别人。
choices.en: Without proof, it's better not to suspect people.

s5.text: 穿西装的先生说他是珠宝商，如果他要偷，也不会偷这么便宜的项链。他看起来很不高兴。
s5.en: The man in the suit says he's a jeweller, and if he were going to steal, he wouldn't steal such a cheap necklace. He looks upset.

choices.text: 我问他怎么知道项链很便宜。
choices.en: I ask him how he knows the necklace is cheap.

choices.text: 我向他道歉，然后继续调查。
choices.en: I apologise to him and keep investigating.

s6.text: 在一个座位下面，你找到了一张北京珠宝店的名片，上面有手写的地址。
s6.en: Under a seat you find a business card from a jeweller's in Beijing, with a handwritten address on it.

choices.text: 我把名片给穿西装的先生看。
choices.en: I show the card to the man in the suit.
I show the card to the attendant.

s7.text: 琴盒里面是……另一把小吉他！音乐家说那是送给女儿的礼物。你觉得有点不好意思。
s7.en: Inside the case is… another, smaller guitar! The musician says it's a present for his daughter. You feel a bit embarrassed.

choices.text: 我向他道歉，然后去找穿西装的先生。
choices.en: I apologise and go to find the man in the suit.
I go back and search the aisle again.

s8.text: 穿西装的先生脸色一下子变白了：谁也没说过项链很便宜。要是他没有近距离看过，他不可能知道。
s8.en: The man in the suit suddenly goes pale: nobody had said the necklace was cheap. If he hadn't looked at it up close, he couldn't have known.

choices.text: 我请他在警察来之前把项链还回去。
choices.en: I ask him to give the necklace back before the police come.

choices.text: 我什么也不说，直接叫列车员。
choices.en: I say nothing and call the attendant straight away.

s9.text: 列车员认出了珠宝店的名字：老板就在隔壁车厢，正是那位穿西装的先生。
s9.en: The attendant recognises the jeweller's name: the owner is in the next carriage. It's the man in the suit.

choices.text: 我们一起去跟他谈谈吧。
choices.en: Let's go and talk to him together.

choices.text: 我们在下一站等警察吧。
choices.en: Let's wait for the police at the next station.

end_confess.text: 他很惭愧，从口袋里拿出了项链。乘客拿回了项链，天亮的时候还请你喝了一杯咖啡。案子漂亮地破了！
end_confess.en: Ashamed, he takes the necklace out of his pocket. The passenger gets it back and buys you a coffee at dawn. Case solved in style!

end_police.text: 到站以后，警察在他的行李箱里找到了项链。案子破了，可是火车晚到了两个小时。
end_police.en: At the station, the police find the necklace in his suitcase. Case solved, but the train arrives two hours late.

calls.title: 叫出租车
calls.setting: You need a taxi to the airport. You call the taxi company.

lines.text: 您好，这里是出租车公司。请问有什么可以帮您？
lines.en: Hello, this is the taxi company. How can I help you?

lines.text: 您好，我要叫一辆出租车。
lines.en: Hello, I'd like to call a taxi.
Sure. Where are you?
I'm at number five, Renmin Road.
Where would you like to go?
I'm going to the airport.
OK, the car will be there in ten minutes.
Thank you.
You're welcome. Have a safe trip!

calls.title: 订位子
calls.setting: You call a restaurant to book a table for Saturday.

lines.en: Hello, Old Beijing Restaurant.
Hello, I'd like to book a table.
For how many people?
Four people.
Which day? What time?
Saturday at seven in the evening.
May I have your surname?
My surname is Li.
All right, Mr Li, see you on Saturday!
Thanks, see you on Saturday.

calls.title: 诊所来电
calls.setting: The clinic calls to confirm your appointment, but Thursday doesn't work for you.

lines.text: 您好，这里是社区诊所。请问是李先生吗？
lines.en: Hello, this is the community clinic. Is that Mr Li?
Speaking, hello.

lines.text: 我打电话来确认一下，您星期四上午九点的预约。
lines.en: I'm calling to confirm your appointment on Thursday at nine a.m.

lines.text: 不好意思，星期四我去不了。可以改时间吗？
lines.en: Sorry, I can't make Thursday. Can I change the time?

lines.text: 可以。星期五上午十一点，或者星期一下午三点，都有空。
lines.en: Yes. Friday at eleven a.m. or Monday at three p.m. are both free.

lines.text: 星期五上午十一点吧，没问题。
lines.en: Friday at eleven a.m., then. That's fine.

lines.text: 好的，改到星期五了。请记得带身份证。
lines.en: OK, it's moved to Friday. Please remember to bring your ID.
All right, thank you.
You're welcome, goodbye!

calls.title: 找不到路的外卖小哥
calls.setting: The delivery driver calls: he can't find your building, and part of your order is missing.

lines.text: 喂，您好，我是送外卖的。您的餐到了，可是我找不到您的楼。
lines.en: Hello, I'm your delivery driver. Your food is here, but I can't find your building.
Hello, where are you now?

lines.text: 我在一个大药店门口，旁边是一家银行。
lines.en: I'm outside a big pharmacy, next to a bank.

lines.text: 我知道了。您一直往前走，到红绿灯往左拐。
lines.en: I know where you are. Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic lights.

lines.text: 好，拐过来了。是不是一栋白色的楼，门是蓝色的？
lines.en: OK, I've turned. Is it a white building with a blue door?

lines.text: 对，就是那栋。您按三零二的门铃，我给您开门。
lines.en: Yes, that's the one. Ring the bell for 302 and I'll let you in.

lines.text: 好的。还有一件事：您点的饮料卖完了。您要换一个，还是退钱？
lines.en: OK. One more thing: the drink you ordered is sold out. Would you like a different one, or a refund?
A refund then, thanks.

lines.text: 没问题，我马上帮您处理。两分钟就到。
lines.en: No problem, I'll sort it out right away. I'll be there in two minutes.
OK, I'll wait for you downstairs.

slang.means: are you there? (a common way to start a chat)

options.why: Way too formal for texting a friend.
That doesn't answer her.

messages.en: Shall we go and see a film tonight? 🍿

options.why: A bit dramatic for a movie invite!
She already knows your name.

messages.en: Eight o'clock 😎 don't be late haha

options.en: Haha don't worry, I'll be on time 👍

options.why: You know what a film is!
The film is tonight.

messages.en: Where are you? We're all here 😅

options.text: 不好意思，我迟到了，马上到 🙏
options.en: Sorry, I'm late, be there right away 🙏

options.why: He's asking where you are, not how you are.

options.text: 我一个小时以前就到了。
options.en: I got there an hour ago.
options.why: Then they'd see you!

messages.text: 没事哈哈。给你点个喝的？
messages.en: No worries haha. Shall we order you a drink?

options.why: That's just strange.
You can't order a whole restaurant.

messages.text: 好 👌 对了，三环堵死了，你打车吧
messages.en: OK 👌 by the way, the Third Ring Road is jammed, take a taxi

options.text: 好，谢谢提醒，我打车过去 🚕
options.en: OK, thanks for the heads-up, I'll take a taxi 🚕

options.why: 堵死了 just means the traffic is completely jammed.
You're meeting friends, not going to the airport.

messages.text: 宝子们！星期六是佳佳的生日 🎂 我们给她办个生日惊喜吧？
messages.en: Guys! Saturday is Jiajia's birthday 🎂 shall we throw her a surprise party?

options.en: Great idea! Where shall we have it? 🎉

options.why: Jiajia is your friend!
It's Jiajia's birthday, not Xiaomei's.

messages.text: 在我家！你买蛋糕好不好？🙏
messages.en: At my place! Could you buy the cake? 🙏

options.text: 没问题，蛋糕包在我身上 🍰
options.en: No problem, leave the cake to me 🍰

options.why: Rude! And not true.
She asked about the cake.

messages.text: 你太棒了！！嘘 🤫 别让佳佳知道
messages.en: You're the best!! Shh 🤫 don't let Jiajia find out

options.en: Haha don't worry, I won't tell 🤐

options.why: That ruins the surprise!
你太棒了 is a compliment: you're the best.

slang.means: enjoy the gossip from the sidelines (“eat melon”)

messages.en: Oh my god, I've got some big gossip 👀👀

options.en: Quick, tell me, I'm here for the gossip 😱
I don't like chatting with friends.
options.why: An odd thing to text a friend.
八卦 means gossip.

messages.text: 大伟和小丽分手了 💔 而且她已经有新男朋友了 🙊
messages.en: Dawei and Xiaoli broke up 💔 and she already has a new boyfriend 🙊

options.text: 真的假的？好尴尬啊……大伟还好吗？
options.en: Seriously? How awkward… is Dawei OK?

options.why: They broke up: there's no wedding.
That's mean!

messages.text: 他还行，说这样也好哈哈。不过别说是我告诉你的 🤫
messages.en: He's alright, says it's for the best haha. But don't say I told you 🤫

options.en: Don't worry, my lips are sealed 🤐😂
I already posted it on Moments.
options.why: She asked you to keep it secret!
You know Tingting: you're chatting with her.

messages.text: 哈哈哈所以我最喜欢你了 😂 回头聊
messages.en: Hahaha that's why you're my favourite 😂 talk later

intro.text: 哎呀！我忘了“{w}”是什么了。你能给我解释一下吗？
intro.en: Oh no! I forgot what “{w}” is. Can you explain it to me?

yes.text: 啊，对对对！我想起来了！谢谢你！
yes.en: Ah, yes yes yes! I remember now! Thank you!

no.text: 嗯……我还是不明白。能再给我一点提示吗？
no.en: Hmm… I still don't get it. Can you give me another hint?

words.explain: 这是一个小小的金属东西，用来开门。
words.explainEn: It's a small metal thing you use to open the door.

words.explain: 下雨的时候用它，这样你就不会淋湿。
words.explainEn: You use it when it rains, so you don't get wet.

words.explain: 这是厨房里很冷的电器，用来放牛奶和吃的东西。
words.explainEn: It's a cold appliance in the kitchen for keeping milk and food.
You use it to brush your teeth in the morning and at night.

words.explain: 这是早上会响的钟，叫你起床。
words.explainEn: It's a clock that rings in the morning to get you up.

words.explain: 这是放钱和银行卡的东西，一般放在口袋里。
words.explainEn: It's what you keep your money and bank cards in, usually in your pocket.

words.explain: 这是在大楼里带你上楼、下楼的机器，不用走楼梯。
words.explainEn: It's a machine that takes you up and down in a building, so you don't take the stairs.

words.explain: 天冷的时候，围在脖子上的长长的东西。
words.explainEn: A long thing you wrap around your neck when it's cold.

words.explain: 想念过去的时候，心里那种淡淡的感觉。
words.explainEn: That faint feeling in your heart when you miss the past.

words.explain: 很晚还不睡觉，一直到半夜，甚至到天亮。
words.explainEn: Not going to sleep until very late, until midnight or even dawn.

words.explain: 吃完晚饭以后，很晚的时候再吃的东西。
words.explainEn: Food you eat very late, after you've had dinner.

words.explain: 存在银行里、没有花掉的钱。
words.explainEn: Money you've put in the bank and haven't spent.

spot.why: Age doesn't take 是: 我今年二十岁 (or just 我二十岁).
Animals like cats take the measure word 只: 两只猫.
Books take the measure word 本: 三本书.
Before a measure word, “two” is 两, not 二: 两个.

spot.en: Yesterday I didn't go to work.
spot.why: For something that didn't happen in the past, use 没, not 不.
With 比 you can't use 很: 我比他高, or 我比他更高.
How something is done takes 得: 唱得很好听.
“Again” in the future is 再; 在 means “at” or “-ing”.

spot.en: He came yesterday, and he came again today.
spot.why: “Again” for something that already happened is 又.

spot.en: I'm not very clear about this question.
Although he was very busy, he still came.
spot.why: 虽然… pairs with 还是 (still): 他还是来了.

spot.en: He can speak not only English but also French.
spot.why: 不但… pairs with 而且 (and also).

spot.en: As long as you work hard, you can succeed.
spot.why: 只要… pairs with 就; it's 只有… that pairs with 才.

spot.en: Because it rained, we didn't go to the park.
spot.why: 因为… pairs with 所以 (so), not 但是.

spot.en: Even if it snows tomorrow, I'll still go.
spot.why: 即使… pairs with 也 (even so).

missions.title: 点一杯咖啡
missions.task: Order a coffee or a tea in Mandarin at a café, or practise with a friend playing the server.

missions.title: 跟人打招呼
missions.task: Say hello and ask how someone is, in Mandarin: a neighbour, a coworker or a shop assistant.

missions.title: 用中文数数
missions.task: Count your change, your steps or your shopping out loud in Mandarin today, up to twenty.

missions.title: 问路
missions.task: Ask someone for directions in Mandarin, or ask your map app in Mandarin and repeat the answer.

phrases.en: Excuse me, where's the subway station?

missions.title: 手机换成中文
missions.task: Switch your phone, or one app you use a lot, to Chinese for a whole day.

missions.title: 发一条语音
missions.task: Send a 30-second voice message in Mandarin, to a friend or to yourself, about your day.

phrases.text: 上午我工作了，下午休息了一下。
phrases.en: In the morning I worked, and in the afternoon I had a rest.

missions.title: 跟着中文菜谱做饭
missions.task: Cook something by following a recipe or a video in Mandarin.

phrases.en: First, chop the onion into small pieces.

missions.title: 用中文写评价
missions.task: Write a comment or review in Mandarin: a restaurant, a video or a book you liked.

phrases.en: I really like the atmosphere here.
The only thing to improve is the service.

missions.title: 打一个真的电话
missions.task: Make a real phone call in Mandarin: ask a shop or restaurant what time they open and close.

phrases.text: 您好，请问你们明天几点开门？
phrases.en: Hello, what time do you open tomorrow?
What time do you close in the evening?

topics.en: Is a hot dog a sandwich?
topics.title: 热狗算不算三明治？

topics.en: Breakfast is the best meal of the day.
topics.title: 早饭是一天中最好的一顿饭。

topics.en: Social media does more harm than good.
topics.title: 社交媒体弊大于利。

phrases.en: On the one hand…, on the other hand…

phrases.text: 我承认你这一点说得对。
phrases.en: I admit you're right on that point.
